risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have a 'Blue Light of Death' (BLOD) failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting from a cold start to the main menu.

risks.risk: The console might not be hacked (firmware version may be too high).
risks.proof: A photo of Settings > System > System Information showing the software version.

risks.risk: The DualShock 4 controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system or in a controller test app.

risks.risk: The internal hard drive may be failing or have low capacity.
risks.proof: A photo of the Storage settings screen.

proof_requests: Video of the console booting up and navigating the home screen.
Photo of the System Information screen showing the firmware version.
Photo of the Storage settings showing the HDD capacity.
Photo of the back of the console to inspect ports and warranty seals.
response.reason: The item is identified as a Sony PlayStation 4 (original model). It can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional, unhacked unit.
